pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Highly irregular, stellate polygons with jagged, multi-lobed edge gradients. The patches exhibit a 'leaf-like' geometry with sharp angular projections extending into the interstitial spaces.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, wide interstitial pathways of light cream pelage. The network forms a complex topological graph with frequent nodes where three or more pathways intersect, maintaining a relatively consistent pixel thickness across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette created by short, upright hair fibers along the dorsal neck line, contrasting sharply against the blurred background.
